title: Drift Wood #18 · the yearbook
logline: Yearbooks arrive. Everyone signs. Chloe writes one line.

panels.composition: The cafeteria on yearbook day. Everyone signing everyone's. WOOD holding his open, CHLOE writing in it, GULLY drawing in it.

image.prompt: a school cafeteria on yearbook signing day, a teenage boy holding his yearbook open while a girl writes in it and a boy in a backwards cap draws in the margin

panels.composition: Gully's contribution: a small perfect walrus in a sweater vest. 'HAGS — G.'
props: a walrus drawing and HAGS — G.

image.prompt: close-up of a yearbook page with a small ballpoint walrus in a sweater vest drawn in the margin

panels.composition: Chloe's contribution, one line, in her tiny capitals: 'You're going to stay here and I'm going to hate that. — C.'

image.prompt: close-up of a yearbook page with a single line of tiny cramped handwriting and a signature initial
image.notes: The line is the strip's first prophecy. Letter it after.

panels.composition: Wood reading it. Then closing the book. Then opening it again.

balloons.text: ...You spelled 'hate' with a lot of conviction.

image.prompt: a teenage boy in an overcoat closing a yearbook and opening it again, a girl beside him holding hers out to be signed

notes: Chloe's line is the first foreshadowing on the page. The reader will remember it in 2000.
